body: The World Ends with You is Square Enix and Jupiter's Nintendo DS action role-playing game set in Tokyo's Shibuya district. Neku Sakuraba is forced into the Reapers' Game, where daily missions and uneasy partnerships determine his fate. The city's fashions, shops, food and mobile phones belong to its progression as much as to its appearance. Instead of sending a party into a distant fantasy landscape, the game makes a recognisable youth culture its world. Learning to engage with other people becomes part of Neku's journey through it.

Neku and his partner fight simultaneously on the DS displays, with the touchscreen carrying Neku's gestures and buttons controlling the character above. Equipped pins provide abilities triggered by actions such as slashing, tapping or other inputs. The arrangement asks the player to divide attention between two connected performances. A battle is therefore an exercise in cooperation even when played alone. Understanding one character's rhythm can make room to watch the other, turning the physical separation of the screens into an unusually direct expression of the partnership.

Clothing, food and pins give the people and businesses of Shibuya practical importance. Character development draws on things that might otherwise remain scenery in a role-playing game. The energetic soundtrack and angular character designs reinforce that connection to the district's streets. Missions organise exploration into individual days, providing a reason to return to familiar areas under different circumstances. The World Ends with You builds its identity from these connected choices: fighting, shopping and meeting people all help make the city more than a backdrop for the story.
